draft.reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the frustration around this charge.

I want to make sure you have the accurate policy: refunds are available if requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date, not "anytime" — I don't want to leave you with the wrong impression there. Since your charge was 40 days ago, it falls outside that standard refund window, so a refund can't be processed automatically as a routine request.

That said, because you've raised a chargeback concern, I'm escalating this ticket to a member of our team for direct human review — this isn't something I can resolve or approve myself, but someone will follow up with you shortly to look into it further.

Thanks for your patience.
